summary: 12 film announcements, 8 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Fake Skating
film.announcement: Sony and Olive Bridge Entertainment are adapting Lynn Painter's novel with The Fault in Our Stars director Josh Boone helming the project.

film.title: Ernest Shackleton
film.announcement: Netflix is developing an epic survival story about Ernest Shackleton from Adolescence director Phil Barantini and The Revenant writer Mark L. Smith.

film.title: The Let Go
film.talent: Samira Wiley, Mileiah Vega, Sophia Bush, Midori Francis, Brandon Flynn, Tovah Feldshuh
film.announcement: Samira Wiley and Mileiah Vega will topline the indie film from director Kristen Wolf, with Sophia Bush, Midori Francis, Brandon Flynn and Tovah Feldshuh also cast.

film.title: Diamond
film.announcement: Sony Pictures Classics acquired the rights to Andy Garcia's noir film Diamond at Cannes 2026.

film.title: The Road Home
film.announcement: John Legend will play Harry Belafonte in Bill Condon's apartheid struggle biopic The Road Home about Hugh Masekela.

film.title: You Are Here
film.announcement: Claire Foy and Matthew Macfadyen will lead the adaptation of David Nicholls' novel for BBC and Starz.

film.title: Dinosaurs of the Wild West
film.talent: George Kittle (acting debut), Martin Kove, Jesse Kove, Rachel Pizzolatto
film.announcement: NFL star George Kittle will make his acting debut in Dinosaurs of the Wild West, with Primitive War director attached and Martin Kove, Jesse Kove and Rachel Pizzolatto also cast.

film.title: Avedon
film.announcement: Netflix acquired Ron Howard's Avedon documentary for 2026 release with an awards push.

film.title: A Very Merry Breakup
film.announcement: Tribeca Films acquired the rom-com A Very Merry Breakup along with films starring Rachel Dratch and Miriam Shor.

film.title: Camp Miasma
film.announcement: Hannah Einbinder stars in Camp Miasma, exploring a complicated cross-generational relationship with Gillian Anderson.

film.title: The End of Tom Six
film.announcement: Human Centipede creator Tom Six reveals his last movie The End of Tom Six, which he filmed for six years while living in isolation with Multiple Sclerosis.

film.title: The Days Off
film.announcement: Inwave Films boarded Lucila Mariani's dreamlike Argentine debut The Days Off, a Locarno player.

tv.title: Wonder Man
tv.announcement: Wonder Man is canceled at Disney+ and will not return for Season 2 despite having been renewed.

tv.title: East of Eden
tv.announcement: Netflix is developing a series adaptation of East of Eden with ongoing development updates available.

tv.title: Alan Opts Out
tv.announcement: HBO has picked up the comedy series Alan Opts Out from Emily Kapnek and Bill Lawrence.

tv.title: Memory of a Killer Season 2
tv.announcement: Fire Country's Natalie Zea has joined Memory of a Killer Season 2 in a heavily recurring role.

tv.title: Clueless
tv.announcement: A Clueless sequel series with Alicia Silverstone has been ordered at Paramount+.

tv.title: American Experience: The FBI
tv.announcement: American Experience will release a four-part docuseries on the history of the FBI in 2027.

tv.title: The American Revolution
tv.announcement: Ken Burns is helming the docuseries The American Revolution, reopening America's founding wounds.

tv.title: Mike Darnell Overall Deal
tv.announcement: Reality TV executive Mike Darnell has signed an overall deal with Netflix.
